snippet.title: Lexicon Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the thrill of exploration, master your special abilities, and unravel the mysteries that await in Lexicon. With challenging puzzles, stunning visuals, and rich world lore, Lexicon offers a gaming experience like no other!

ABOUT LEXICON
Lexicon is a single-player puzzle adventure game produced by Illum Softworks that invites players to solve mind-bending challenges using familiar 2000s-style flash game mechanics while telling a unique story about a person who finds themselves in the mysterious, and sometimes highly quirky, world of Ekkos.
